influences.name: Van Morrison
influences.context: We ran into Fran, I haven't seen Fran from Travis in a long time so I got to catch up with him a little bit. His new film is a critics' perspective of the band and him getting in touch with what it was like to be a fan again. It's a nice idea. We got to see Van Morrison and that was an unexpected surprise.
